items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I would compare Nat's -- people loving him and really appreciating him to Crosby or Sinatra or any people of that calibre, you know.

ctx.x: Well, I don't know. I still can't figure that out. Really, I can't. And as big a man as her husband was and as successful as he was and as well loved. He

was one of the better loved people in the business, you know. I would compare Nat's -- people loving him and really appreciating him to Crosby or Sinatra or any people of that calibre, you know. I held him in very high esteem as an artist, and as a person. He was a wonderful man. He was just a very beautiful person, and you know, he would not -- now, he would not have condoned anything like that. He wouldn't have said anything to really harm or hurt anyone, Nat wouldn't. He was a great artist, a great artist and…
She's got a talent, and I think whatever she does it's done tastefully.
